records.text: Harken Windtotem is a Tauren of Bloodhoof Village whose work centers on hunting. He asks hunters to bring him Swoop Quills, treating the difficult hunt as a test of cleverness and determination and a way to bring honor to the clan. He recognizes the effort involved and welcomes a successful hunter to the village.

Mull Thunderhorn is a Tauren ritualist working to restore Mulgore's tainted water wells. He crafts cleansing totems from offerings gathered from the land, then entrusts others to carry them to each well and perform the cleansing rites. He treats the pollution as a threat to sacred water and the land, and celebrates the wells' recovery as a service to Bloodhoof village.

A Palemane Tanner is one of the Palemane gnolls found south of Bloodhoof and in a nearby cave. It snarls of fresh meat and bones to gnaw, and uses a shadow spell. The Palemane disrespect the tauren's attempts to communicate and slay Mulgore's wildlife.
A Palemane gnoll skinner, one of the group settled around Mulgore. In its few recorded words, it snarls about fresh meat and bones to gnaw, revealing a predatory threat to the land’s wildlife.

A Palemane gnoll poacher in Mulgore, she is part of the threat to local wildlife that has driven the tauren to abandon attempts at peaceful communication. Her combat taunts about fresh meat and bones give her a predatory, hostile edge.

A Bristleback Quilboar is one of the pig-men targeted by Mankrik's revenge. Bristlebacks near Brambleblade Ravine are described as ambushing tauren hunting parties and stealing from the village, making this quilboar a local threat in the conflict.
A Bristleback shaman who brings lightning magic into combat, casting Lightning Bolt against its foes.
A Windfury harpy of Mulgore that fights with a spell.
A Windfury Wind Witch of Mulgore that fights with spells.
A Windfury Sorceress of Mulgore that fights with a spell.
A Windfury Matriarch, a humanoid who casts a spell in combat.

Battleboars are boars trained by Bristleback quilboars to be malicious. They encroach on the tauren tribe’s hunting grounds around Brambleblade Ravine, where their snouts and flanks are sought for stew.
Galak Centaurs are centaur combatants found in Mulgore.
Galak Outrunners are centaur combatants found in Mulgore.
Wiry Swoops are beasts found in Mulgore.
Swoops are flying animals found across several parts of Kalimdor. A swoop’s gizzard is among the animal parts sought for a remedy to Mazzranache’s venomous bite.
A Taloned Swoop is a wild bird of Mulgore that fights with its talons and casts a spell when badly hurt.
A young kodo of Mulgore that defends itself when threatened.
The Kodo Bull is a kodo of Mulgore that fights when provoked.
A Kodo Matriarch is a kodo of Mulgore that fights when provoked.
A Venture Co. Hireling is a low-ranking member of the company's workforce in the Mulgore. When close to defeat, a hireling may flee to seek help.
A Venture Co. Laborer is part of the company's workforce in the Mulgore. Laborers can be found across several local areas and fight when threatened.
A Venture Co. taskmaster, a goblin overseer of the company's workers in Mulgore, who casts a spell when injured.
A Venture Co. worker, one of the goblin employees whose company is expanding into Mulgore, where the tauren will not allow them to operate. It uses a spell in battle.
A Venture Co. supervisor, one of the goblin employees whose company is expanding into Mulgore, where the tauren will not allow them to operate.

Grull Hawkwind helps provision the Tauren of Narache through hunting requests: meat and feathers for village supplies, boar meat for stew, and cougar pelts for children's clothing and tent repairs. He says he is Chief Hawkwind's son and offers to pass word to his father of those who help.

Chief Hawkwind leads the tauren of Camp Narache while attending to tribal matters. He asks for help checking on his mother after she fails to return from fetching water, showing the personal responsibilities behind his leadership. He also directs young tauren into the Rites of the Earthmother and sends them onward to Baine Bloodhoof as they pursue acceptance among Thunder Bluff’s elders.

Seer Graytongue oversees the Rite of Strength, the first test in the Rites of the Earthmother. He frames it as a test of bravery: bristlebacks are encroaching on tauren lands, ambushing hunters and stealing from the village, and the aspirant must prove valor against them. After Chief Hawkwind sends an aspirant his way, Graytongue directs the completed test back to the chief.

Seer Wiserunner guides tauren through the Rite of Vision, presenting them with the Water of the Seers and directing them to drink it by the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village. He describes the vision as a path to follow toward one’s destiny. Once the rite is passed, he directs the aspirant onward to the Rite of Wisdom at Red Rocks, where an ancestral spirit grants a blessing to those who have drunk the sacred water.

Ruul Eagletalon calls himself a warrior and teacher. He sets a test of strength against the Windfury harpies, describing them as Mulgore's natural enemies and a measure of readiness for travel beyond the region. He wishes the traveler well.

Morin Cloudstalker investigates the Venture Co.'s activity in Mulgore and sees its mining as an attempt to plunder tauren lands after the company was refused rights. He asks for evidence from a ravaged caravan, then directs resistance against the mine and its supervisor. He finds the company's expansion greedy and regards the tauren response as a clear warning.
A digger bearing the Bael'dun name.
An appraiser bearing the Bael'dun name.

Greatmother Hawkwind is an elder of the tribe who still takes responsibility for its duties, though age has slowed her. She asks a young helper to carry water to her son, Chief Hawkwind, and notes that even a humble task can earn elders’ recognition.

Baine Bloodhoof asks people to protect Mulgore from threats that harm its wildlife and land. After Palemane gnolls reject attempts at communication and kill wildlife, he judges words insufficient. He also opposes a dwarven dig that he sees as defiling the earth, and teaches that life and death form a necessary circle and that land and creatures deserve respect.

The Ancestral Spirits speak as the tauren who gave their lives to found and protect Thunder Bluff. After the Rite of Wisdom, they entrust the city's protection to the initiate and welcome them into Thunder Bluff with pride.
Flatland cougars roam the Mulgore plains and surrounding areas.

Supervisor Fizsprocket is named as the Venture Co. mastermind behind plans to drive the Tauren from their lands and leave the way clear for the company to plunder them. Morin Cloudstalker wants him killed and his clipboard recovered, hoping it may contain useful information. He is located at a Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan.

Skorn Whitecloud is an aging Tauren hunter whose wandering days are behind him. He remembers the thrill of hunting and speaks of it as a Tauren's honor. When someone defeats Ghost Howl, he offers one of his own weapons for future hunts, hoping it will strike true and bring renown.

Zarlman Two-Moons guides the village's Rite of Vision. He gathers well stones and ambercorn to brew the Water of the Seers, chanting as he prepares it by the Tribal Fire. The rite is meant to bring a vision that guides the participant toward the next step of the Earthmother's rites.

Maur Raincaller is gravely ill after Mazzranache bit his shoulder. He needs animal parts to prepare a remedy for the spreading infection, and fears he will die if he cannot treat it soon. The encounter also left him with a vivid memory of the strider's shriek and striking colors.
Ghost Howl is a powerful wolf whose ragged hide still bears a terrible wound from battles against the Burning Legion. Whoever brings him down earns the respect of Skorn.
Arra'chea is a mighty kodo of Mulgore, hunted for its horn as a test of tracking and hunting skill after the Rites of the Earthmother.

Harutt Thunderhorn trains new warriors in Camp Narache. Harutt regards warriors as defenders of their tribe’s borders, hunters of the centaur and people called to war. Warriors must share the tribe’s rites and never let pride place them above others. Harutt welcomes those who seek battle’s glory while following the ways of their oldest ancestors.

Gart Mistrunner trains druids at Camp Narache. He says ancestral spirits have grown restless across Mulgore and beyond, and teaches that druids must listen to nature’s spirits and act as their avatars. He regards the Earthmother’s teachings as central to druidic growth and warns that night elf pride can limit their understanding.

Lanka Farshot trains hunters in Camp Narache, teaching practical skills such as taming pets and using rifles. She presents hunting as part of her people’s tradition and urges young hunters to learn Mulgore well before facing unfamiliar lands.

Meela Dawnstrider teaches the ways of the shamanic spirits at Camp Narache. She says she understands the elements and can speak with the spirits of her people, and presents training as a continuing path toward greater power and readiness.
Krang Stonehoof is a warrior trainer who stresses that learning continues no matter how much one already knows.

Gennia Runetotem is a druid trainer who welcomes prospective students and offers instruction. She teaches preservation of balance as Cenarius taught it, describing his light as a beacon to protect. She also directs a druid trainee toward Turak Runetotem for personal training.

Yaw Sharpmane trains hunters and speaks of hunting as a deep Tauren tradition. He presents taming as a way to become closer to nature and, in his lessons, frames the hunter and companion as a team. His instructions invoke the Earthmother and emphasize learning through practice.

Narm Skychaser is a shaman trainer who speaks of the spirits as guides. He values patience in study and introduces fire as destruction and chaos, and water as purity. He directs students to Kranal Fiss for fire and Islen Waterseer for water.

Pyall Silentstride is a cook and cooking trainer who treats the craft as a lifelong pursuit. He points aspiring cooks toward Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan as a master of culinary arts and someone from whom they can improve.

Mazzranache is a named plains strider with a fearsome reputation in Maur Raincaller's account. Maur says the creature's bite infected his shoulder and describes its red eyes, sharp talons and venom. The account identifies Mazzranache as the strider in his grandfather's stories.

Chaw Stronghide is a leatherworking trainer who teaches that a hunter should put every part of a kill to use, including salvaged leather that can reinforce an ally's armor. He sees people as stronger together and argues that the land does not belong to them; they belong to it, and must protect it to survive.
Kawnie Softbreeze is a General Goods merchant selling everyday goods.
Marjak Keenblade is a weaponsmith who sells and repairs weapons.
Varia Hardhide sells leather armor and offers repairs. Her role is focused on leather equipment and its upkeep.
Bronk Steelrage is an armorer and shieldcrafter who sells and repairs armor and shields.
Moorat Longstride is a General Goods merchant selling everyday goods.
Mahnott Roughwound is a weaponsmith who sells and repairs weapons.
Kennah Hawkseye is a gunsmith in Red Cloud Mesa. Visitors can browse his goods.
Varg Windwhisper is a leather armor merchant in Mulgore who invites visitors to browse his goods and asks how he may help.
Harant Ironbrace is an armorer and shieldcrafter in Red Cloud Mesa.
Wunna Darkmane is a trade goods merchant in Red Cloud Mesa.

Brave Windfeather calls on newcomers to defend the tauren home from the Bristleback quilboars and their leader, Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle. She frames the fight as a demanding hunt, one that tests whether a hunter can face an adversary capable of hunting back.
Brave Proudsnout is a Mulgore brave.
Brave Lightninghorn is a Mulgore brave.
Brave Ironhorn helps visitors find the bank, inn, wind rider master and stable master.
A humanoid known as Brave Running Wolf in Mulgore.
Brave Greathoof is a Mulgore brave.
Brave Strongbash helps visitors find the bank, inn, wind rider master and stable master.
Brave Dawneagle helps visitors find the bank, inn, wind rider master and stable master.
Brave Swiftwind asks what visitors are looking for and offers directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, stable master, a class trainer, and a profession trainer.
Brave Leaping Deer asks what visitors are looking for and offers directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, stable master, a class trainer, and a profession trainer.
Brave Darksky asks what visitors are looking for and offers directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, stable master, a class trainer, and a profession trainer.
Brave Rockhorn asks what visitors are looking for and offers directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, stable master, a class trainer, and a profession trainer.
Brave Wildrunner asks what visitors are looking for and offers directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, stable master, a class trainer, and a profession trainer.
Brave Rainchaser asks what visitors are looking for and offers directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, stable master, a class trainer, and a profession trainer.
Brave Cloudmane helps visitors find the bank, inn, wind rider master and stable master.
“Squealer” Thornmantle is a humanoid associated with Mulgore.

Bristleback Interlopers ravage the sacred tauren burial ground at Red Rocks. Lorekeeper Raintotem seeks their removal to protect the graves of warriors who founded and defended Thunder Bluff and served their tribes. The interlopers fight with Muscle Tear.

Lorekeeper Raintotem cherishes Red Rocks as the sacred burial ground of valiant tauren who founded and defended Thunder Bluff or gave their lives for their tribes. Too old to drive off the Bristleback Interlopers himself, he seeks help protecting this holy place.
Flatland Prowlers are beasts found across several areas.
Harb Clawhoof is a tauren kodo merchant. He describes the animals as raised on Mulgore’s Golden Plains and cared for by his people, and invites customers to browse his selection.
Reban Freerunner is a pet trainer who only helps hunters and their pets, offering training for hunters to pass on to their pets.
Kar Stormsinger is a riding trainer who teaches the finer points of kodo riding. A pamphlet associated with Kar advertises riding training and mount purchases.
Moodan Sungrain is a baker who sells baked goods in Mulgore.
Jhawna Oatwind is a baker who sells baked goods in Mulgore.
Sister Hatelash is a humanoid found in Mulgore.
Snagglespear is a rare humanoid of Mulgore that casts a spell as soon as it takes notice of an enemy.
Enforcer Emilgund is a humanoid of Mulgore who goes into a frenzy when badly wounded.
The Rake is a beast found in Mulgore.

Seer Ravenfeather guides young tauren shamans through the earth rite, teaching patience, stamina, and respect for the Earth Mother. After the student returns with ritual salve, Ravenfeather prepares an Earth Sapta and explains the earth’s strength and wisdom. Ravenfeather also crafts an earth totem and provides a scroll for a first earth ability, wishing the student peace and patience.
A Redrock Earth Spirit is an elemental that can turn itself invisible.
Uthan Stillwater is a fishing trainer in Bloodhoof Village.
Vira Younghoof teaches First Aid in Bloodhoof Village. Her training dialogue notes that advanced instruction is available from Doctor Gregory Victor at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Harn Longcast supplies fishing goods in Bloodhoof Village, where visitors can browse his wares.
Yonn Deepcut is a skinning trainer in Bloodhoof Village.

Innkeeper Kauth welcomes travelers at the Bloodhoof Village inn, where he offers lodging, food and goods. He describes the inn as open to his people and encourages travelers to rest. Kauth receives the bundle of furs that Antur Fallow was asked by his father to deliver while completing his Rite of Strength.

Antur Fallow is a young tauren in the middle of his Rite of Strength. His father asked him to deliver a bundle of furs to the Bloodhoof Village inn, but Antur says he is not rested enough to finish both the rite and the delivery, and asks for help carrying out the task.
Magrin Rivermane is a humanoid in Mulgore.
A Mulgore Protector is a humanoid associated by title with protecting Mulgore.
Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine in their ongoing conflict with the tauren.
Seikwa is a stable master associated with pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
Hulfnar Stonetotem is a humanoid in Mulgore.
Thontek Rumblehoof is a humanoid in Mulgore.
A novice warrior.
Twizwick Sprocketgrind is an engineering trainer.
Var'jun is urgently searching for someone and asks to be left alone while he looks. He gives no clue here about whom he seeks.
Vorn Skyseer welcomes newcomers to Azeroth in Bloodhoof Village and gives a little companion as a gift to those who bring a special voucher.
A brown kodo kept as a riding mount.
A gray kodo kept as a riding mount.
The Great White Kodo is a beast distinguished by its white coloring.
The Great Brown Kodo is a beast distinguished by its brown coloring.
The Great Gray Kodo is a beast distinguished by its gray coloring.
Jubjub is a beast.
Elder Bloodhoof looks back on a time when his people hunted for glory and honor, and wonders whether life has really changed. His words show a reflective regard for the past.
Kyle is Ahab Wheathoof's prized puppy, who ran away hungry. His favorite food is tender strider meat, and he howls with delight when he sees lunch before eating.

Ahab Wheathoof is the old rancher of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, where he lives with his prized puppy, Kyle. When Kyle goes missing, Ahab’s worry shows how dearly he loves him; he asks passersby to find and feed the dog, whose favorite food is tender strider meat. Ahab’s story centers on getting Kyle home, and his brief remarks reveal a grieving, devoted owner rather than a broader public role.

The Mulgore Flame Keeper tends the Horde festival flame in Mulgore. The keeper welcomes visitors who come to honor it and urges the Horde to honor its fires while desecrating Alliance flames, reflecting the festival’s factional rivalry.
A white kodo found in Mulgore.

place_records.text: You are in Mulgore, Horde land on the Kalimdor continent. Tauren keep it from Camp Narache and Bloodhoof Village, and its plains are home to prairie wolves, stalkers and cougars. Venture Co. goblins run a mine here, and bristleback quilboars live in Brambleblade Ravine.

You are in Red Cloud Mesa, a tauren mesa in Mulgore. Seer Graytongue oversees the Rite of Strength, a tribal test of bravery against the bristleback quilboars who encroach on tauren land. A spirit healer serves the mesa.

You are in Camp Narache, a tauren camp in Mulgore. Chief Hawkwind leads its tauren, and it has trainers of magic and arms, a weaponsmith and repairs. Bristleback quilboars plan a siege on the camp, and Brave Windfeather urges newcomers to help defend it.

You are in Bloodhoof Village, a tauren village in Mulgore with an inn, a stable master, and trainers of magic, arms and professions. Baine Bloodhoof wants Mulgore's wildlife protected from the Palemane gnolls, who kill it and reject talks, and he opposes a dwarven dig he sees as defiling the land. Morin Cloudstalker directs resistance against the Venture Co. mine.

You are in Stonebull Lake, a lake in Mulgore. Uthan Stillwater, a Horde fishing trainer, teaches here, and prairie wolves and stalkers prowl its shore. The old rancher Ahab Wheathoof is missing his puppy Kyle, which ran off hungry.

You are in the Ravaged Caravan, a burned caravan site on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. Venture Co. laborers and taskmasters roam the wreckage, and a cougar or swoop may be near. Ore and papers from the caravan still lie here.

You are in Red Rocks, the sacred burial ground of the tauren, east of Thunder Bluff. Lorekeeper Raintotem keeps watch over it, and a spirit healer serves here. He is too old to drive off the Bristleback Interlopers ravaging the graves.

You are in Brambleblade Ravine, a ravine east of Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Bristleback quilboars live here under Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, in an ongoing conflict with the tauren. Their shamans cast lightning, and they ambush tauren hunting parties.
You are in The Venture Co. Mine, a goblin mining site in Mulgore. Venture Co. workers and supervisors dig here, and Morin Cloudstalker of Bloodhoof Village directs resistance against it.
You are in Winterhoof Water Well, a water well in Mulgore. Venture Co. hirelings guard it, and prairie wolves roam nearby. Tauren say goblins have tainted the sacred water wells.
You are in Thunderhorn Water Well, a water well in Mulgore. Venture Co. laborers and taskmasters work near it, while prairie stalkers, flatland cougars and swoops prowl the grass.
You are in Wildmane Water Well, a water well in Mulgore. Venture Co. workers and supervisors are here, along with flatland prowlers and prairie wolf alphas.
You are in Bael'dun Digsite, a dig in Mulgore where two Alliance diggers and appraisers bearing the Bael'dun name work. A swoop is known to hunt nearby.

You are in Kodo Rock, a rocky part of Horde-held Mulgore. Earth spirits keep to the rock here, among them a Minor Manifestation of Earth and a Redrock Earth Spirit. Battleboars, boars trained by Bristleback quilboars to be malicious, encroach on the tauren hunting grounds around Brambleblade Ravine.
You are in Palemane Rock, a rocky part of Mulgore haunted by prairie wolves and by Palemane tanners and skinners.

You are in Windfury Ridge, a high part of Mulgore where Windfury matriarchs and sorceresses, prairie wolves and taloned swoops are the trouble. Arra'chea, a mighty kodo, is hunted here for its horn as a test of tracking and hunting skill.
You are in The Golden Plains, open grassland in Mulgore where flatland cougars, flatland prowlers, prairie stalkers, prairie wolves and swoops roam.

You are in The Rolling Plains, grassland in Mulgore where a spirit healer offers a return to the living for a price. Windfury harpies, wind witches, prairie wolves, prairie stalkers and Galak centaurs roam here.
